# Accounts Meeting 2026-01-21

One-hour meeting with [[neil-gathercole]] at his office to close the [[accounts-2025|2025 accounts]].

## Decided

- **Teaching income** counted in 2025 on an invoice basis (800 GBP invoiced in December, received 2026-01-09).
- **Use of home as office**: 312 GBP, on his flat-rate method for hours worked at home. I had worked it out at 480 GBP by floor area; he preferred the method that does not need a floor plan in the file.
- **Research travel**: 640 GBP, accepted, but he wants a log kept as I go from now on, with dates, purpose and mileage. Started as [[research-travel-log-2026]].
- **Books**: research books for The Salt Choir allowable; novels I read for pleasure not, even when I tell him they are research. We argued about one; I lost.
- **Agency commission**: 1,800 GBP, allowable in full. He asked for a single annual commission statement from the agency next year.

## Numbers

Gross 14,464 GBP, expenses 3,762 GBP, profit 10,702 GBP. Filed 2026-01-30 ([[accounts-2025-summary-from-neil]]).

## Also Discussed

The Salt Choir signature tranche of 8,000 GBP falls entirely in 2025. Neil noted that 2026 would have no advance income at all if delivery slipped into 2027. In January that seemed unlikely.
